# CapCut
> CapCut is an AI-powered video editing platform for creating, editing, and publishing videos online, on desktop, and on mobile.

CapCut provides browser-based editing, desktop and mobile apps, AI media generation tools, templates, and creator/business workflows for social video production.

## Main Product
- [CapCut Online Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/): Browser-based video editor with AI-assisted editing, effects, captions, and publishing tools.
- [CapCut Desktop](https://www.capcut.com/tools/desktop-video-editor): Desktop video editor for longer-form editing, effects, and local workflows.
- [CapCut Mobile App](https://www.capcut.com/tools/mobile-video-editor): Mobile editing app for short-form video creation and social publishing.
- [CapCut Commerce Pro](https://www.capcut.com/business/commerce-pro): Business-focused creative workflow tools for marketing, ads, and product content.
- [CapCut for Business](https://www.capcut.com/business): Business video creation platform for teams, brands, and campaign production.

## AI Tools
- [AI Video Generator](https://www.capcut.com/tools/ai-video-generator): Generate videos with AI-assisted creation workflows from prompts or assets.
- [AI Avatar Generator](https://www.capcut.com/tools/ai-avatar-generator): Create talking avatars and presenter-style videos using AI-generated characters.
- [AI Voice Generator](https://www.capcut.com/tools/ai-voice-generator): Generate synthetic voiceovers for videos in multiple styles and languages.
- [Text to Speech](https://www.capcut.com/tools/text-to-speech): Convert written scripts into spoken audio for narration and voiceover.
- [Speech to Text](https://www.capcut.com/tools/speech-to-text): Transcribe spoken audio into editable text and subtitle tracks.
- [Auto Captions](https://www.capcut.com/tools/auto-captions): Automatically generate captions and subtitles for video content.
- [AI Background Remover](https://www.capcut.com/tools/background-remover): Remove image or video backgrounds with AI-based subject detection.
- [AI Color Correction](https://www.capcut.com/tools/color-correction): Enhance footage colors automatically using AI-assisted grading tools.

## Video Editing Tools
- [Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/video-editor): General-purpose online video editing with timeline, effects, and export controls.
- [Video Trimmer](https://www.capcut.com/tools/video-trimmer): Cut and shorten video clips quickly in the browser.
- [Video Resizer](https://www.capcut.com/tools/video-resizer): Resize videos for different aspect ratios and social platforms.
- [Video Compressor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/video-compressor): Reduce video file size while preserving usable visual quality.
- [Video Converter](https://www.capcut.com/tools/video-converter): Convert video files between supported formats for editing and publishing.
- [Screen Recorder](https://www.capcut.com/tools/screen-recorder): Record screen content for tutorials, demos, and presentations.
- [Subtitle Generator](https://www.capcut.com/tools/subtitle-generator): Create and edit subtitles for accessibility and social viewing.
- [Slideshow Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/slideshow-maker): Turn photos and clips into animated slideshow videos.

## Image and Audio Tools
- [Photo Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/photo-editor): Edit images online with filters, adjustments, and design tools.
- [Image Upscaler](https://www.capcut.com/tools/image-upscaler): Improve image resolution and clarity using AI enhancement.
- [Image Background Remover](https://www.capcut.com/tools/image-background-remover): Remove backgrounds from still images for design and product use.
- [Audio Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/audio-editor): Edit audio tracks, trim clips, and refine sound for video projects.
- [Noise Reduction](https://www.capcut.com/tools/noise-reduction): Reduce background noise in recordings for cleaner dialogue and narration.
- [Voice Changer](https://www.capcut.com/tools/voice-changer): Modify voice characteristics for creative or character-based audio.
- [Sound Effects](https://www.capcut.com/tools/sound-effects): Add sound effects to videos for emphasis, transitions, and storytelling.

## Templates and Creative Assets
- [Templates](https://www.capcut.com/templates): Ready-made video templates for social, business, and creator workflows.
- [Trending Templates](https://www.capcut.com/templates/trending): Popular template collection based on current creator and social trends.
- [Video Templates](https://www.capcut.com/templates/video): Prebuilt video layouts for quick editing and publishing.
- [Photo Templates](https://www.capcut.com/templates/photo): Template-based image and photo compositions for social content.
- [Business Templates](https://www.capcut.com/templates/business): Marketing-oriented templates for promotions, products, and brand content.
- [Intro Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/intro-maker): Create branded intros and opening sequences for videos.
- [Outro Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/outro-maker): Build ending cards and closing sequences for video branding.

## Use Cases
- [YouTube Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/youtube-video-editor): Editing workflow tailored for YouTube videos and channel publishing.
- [TikTok Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/tiktok-video-editor): Create short-form vertical videos optimized for TikTok-style content.
- [Instagram Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/instagram-video-editor): Produce reels, stories, and feed videos for Instagram formats.
- [Podcast Video Editor](https://www.capcut.com/tools/podcast-video-editor): Edit podcast clips and video episodes with captions and layouts.
- [Marketing Video Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/marketing-video-maker): Create promotional videos for campaigns, products, and ads.
- [Product Video Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/product-video-maker): Build product-focused videos for ecommerce and social selling.
- [Presentation Video Maker](https://www.capcut.com/tools/presentation-video-maker): Turn slides and talking points into presentation-style videos.
